page.layout: One page of text: running head at top centre; a heading line with a number at right; a woodcut illustration full width; below it a verse epigram with a large initial S; a signature word "Phœnix" at lower right.

main_text.head: Faber incudem ipsam tundens. V.
main_text.p: [woodcut illustration: a smith striking an anvil with a hammer, a workshop with a chimney and a tub; no text]

p.i: Cilicet incudem insanit qui frangere duri
Et non insanit Christo qui perdere sacra

page.notes: The initial S is a large woodcut letter, joined to "Cilicet" in the transcription. The woodcut shows a smith at an anvil; the printed line "durum" is cut off at the right edge of the scan, so the last word of line one reads "dur[?]". The word "posse" is printed as "pofse" with long s, normalised to s.
